THE LAST ONE EVER.
This August is your final chance to experience our Yoga Teacher Training as a 21-day immersive! After this, this format is gone.
Yoga can completely change how you experience stress, anxiety, difficult emotions, and the pressures of everyday life. In this short film, five people share how yoga, meditation, and breath helped them become more present, grounded, peaceful, and able to respond instead of react.
